name: authority
caption: Authority
description: Per-record authorization decisions: whether a specific actor was permitted to perform a specific action on a specific record, under which delegated authority, with which reason code, and with what verifiable evidence. Complements Authorize Session (3003), which describes session-level privilege assignment rather than a decision about an individual record.
_registration_note: OCSF requires extensions to be registered to receive a unique identifier range. `uid` MUST be replaced with the allocated value before publication. The validator fails if this note is removed while uid is still the placeholder.
